description: Source code for managing auto-commit behavior of radio devices, including timers, configuration, and notifications for radio, access point, and endpoint edits.

methods.name: s_startRadioAutoCommit
methods.description: Starts the auto-commit timer for a radio if conditions are met.

methods.name: wld_autoCommitMgr_notifyRadEdit
methods.description: Handles notification that a radio's FSM has been edited and may trigger auto-commit.

methods.name: s_autoCommit_th
methods.description: Timer callback to perform auto-commit if unblocked.

methods.name: s_radInit
methods.description: Initializes auto-commit timer for a radio.

methods.name: s_radDestroy
methods.description: Destroys auto-commit timer for a radio.

methods.name: wld_autoCommitMgr_notifyVapEdit
methods.description: Handles notification that a VAP's FSM has been edited and may trigger auto-commit.

methods.name: wld_autoCommitMgr_notifyEpEdit
methods.description: Handles notification that an endpoint's FSM has been edited and may trigger auto-commit.

methods.name: wld_autoCommitMgr_init
methods.description: Initializes auto-commit management for a radio.

methods.name: wld_autoCommitMgr_destroy
methods.description: Destroys auto-commit management for a radio.

methods.name: s_initAutoCommit
methods.description: Initializes auto-commit timers for all radios.

methods.name: s_cleanAutoCommit
methods.description: Cleans up auto-commit timers for all radios.

methods.name: s_setEnable_pwf
methods.description: Sets the enable flag for auto-commit management and initializes or cleans up accordingly.

methods.name: s_setDelayTime_pwf
methods.description: Sets the delay time for auto-commit and reinitializes timers if enabled.

methods.name: s_setBootDelayTime_pwf
methods.description: Sets the boot delay time for auto-commit and reinitializes timers if enabled.

methods.name: _wld_autoCommitMgr_setConf_ocf
methods.description: Handles configuration updates for auto-commit management.

methods.name: _AutoCommitMgr_debug
methods.description: Provides debug information about auto-commit configuration and radio states.
